body:
Founder real-time, across ~10 messages: new REDGARDEN game mode "ECOWAR" -- maps to the original
vertical-slice doc's "Ecosystem War (2v2)" mode but reframed as a genre synthesis ("bringing the
moba full circle back to RTS with TCG as the moonchild... deck building as the affordance for
commanding your army"). Separate game mode, separate matchmaking, separate client (client
unification explicitly deferred -- "we will unify clients later," existing headless bot client
is fine for now).

Wrote REDGARDEN/NORTHSTAR.md §29, checked directly against real code before writing anything:
packages/simulation/local_game.c/.h (the existing 274/54-line card-RTS MVP -- 4 cards, GridCell
automaton, influence economy, an unused tech_tier[3] field) and arena_game.c/.h (26 heroes, 33
items, the full bot AI research program) are two genuinely separate, already-isolated codepaths
neither of which has ever shared state -- apps/matchmaker's own dual-role pattern (same binary,
--lobby-size/--server-bin flags switch between card-RTS and arena team modes) is a real, direct
precedent for how ECOWAR's own matchmaking should probably work.

Explicitly scoping-only, not a build: 4 real open architecture questions flagged rather than
guessed at (does the player get a directly-piloted hero too, or purely command via cards; are
army units full hero kits or a simpler tier; what "dragon objective" mechanically means; which
simulation loop ECOWAR actually runs on). No milestone plan written -- matches this repo's own
established discipline of not inventing milestone numbers ahead of a real design decision.
title: ECOWAR NORTHSTAR §29: scoping doc, genre-synthesis game mode
